description: Canonical registry of the ODSP-AW automation cadences. Two kinds: (1) Copilot CLI scheduled prompts that need live conversation/session context (these live in CLI state, not the repo, so they vanish on a state reset); (2) headless agent Windows Scheduled Tasks that run scripts/run-agent-prompt.ps1 so the heavier daily/weekly judgment cadences fire reliably even when no interactive CLI is open. To restore, see automation/RESTORE-SCHEDULES.md.

cliSchedules.summary: Top-of-hour board audit + effort ticker (judgment only; needs the live CLI conversation to capture Ambal's asks). Deterministic upkeep is the ODSP-AW-Hourly-Maintenance Windows task.
cliSchedules.prompt: Top-of-hour ODSP-AW Command Center maintenance - lightweight, just the judgment work (the deterministic upkeep also runs as the ODSP-AW-Hourly-Maintenance Windows task, so it happens even when the CLI is closed). (1) AUDIT the "What I Am Working On" board (the progressBoard array in C:\Repo\OneDrive-SharePoint-in-Agentic-Work\Data-Private\Data-Created\ODSP-AW-CC.html): add a row for EVERY ask Ambal made in the past hour that is missing; keep statuses honest (queued = pending, never a false in-progress); nothing Ambal prompted should ever be lost. (2) DAILY EFFORT TICKER (the effortTicker array): ensure TODAY's row (CST) sits at the TOP with inProgress:true - prepend if missing; refresh today's Operations/Data Wrangling/Insights Generation split + Ambal's prompt count from the day's work log (the board, statusLog + git activity); if the PREVIOUS day's row is still inProgress, close it out and finalize its note. Estimate from the work log - never fabricate a number; mark any reconstructed figure approximate. (3) Then run, in PowerShell: & 'C:\Repo\OneDrive-SharePoint-in-Agentic-Work\scripts\cc-maintenance.ps1' (validate + snapshot + rebuild the Decisions/Activity archives + index + memo pages). Data scrape/ingest + the full Data Health re-verify now run at the 7am refresh + nightly, not hourly; the storage report is nightly. Do NOT open a browser. Keep it silent and concise.

cliSchedules.summary: Morning attention - keeps the consolidated 'What Needs You' list (needFromYou) in the Tracker current (8:00 AM CST).
cliSchedules.prompt: Morning "What Needs You" refresh (8:00 AM CST). In C:\Repo\OneDrive-SharePoint-in-Agentic-Work\Data-Private\Data-Created\ODSP-AW-CC.html, keep the single consolidated "What Needs You" list in the Tracker current (the needFromYou array, rendered as the active-need tbody): (a) add any new item only Ambal can move that surfaced since yesterday; (b) re-verify each open item's status (open / parked / watching / resolved) + priority, marking today's must-acts as top priority so they lead; (c) mark resolved anything Ambal cleared; never show a false status, and nothing Ambal needs should ever be lost. Pull data-freshness blockers from the Data Health tab (e.g., CoWork stale -> the re-auth item nfy7). Then run, in PowerShell: & 'C:\Repo\OneDrive-SharePoint-in-Agentic-Work\scripts\cc-maintenance.ps1'. Do NOT open a browser. Keep it silent and concise.

agentCadenceTasks.note: Headless agent cadences. Each is a Windows Scheduled Task (user ambalb, LogonType Interactive, RunLevel Limited, StartWhenAvailable) that runs powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File scripts\run-agent-prompt.ps1 -PromptFile <prompt> -Name <name>. The wrapper invokes copilot -p <prompt> --allow-all-tools --allow-all-paths --no-ask-user -s, then safety-net commits + pushes and logs to automation/agent-logs/ (gitignored). These replaced the equivalent CLI schedules, which only fired when an interactive CLI was open + idle. To recreate, run scripts/register-agent-tasks.ps1.

tasks.name: ODSP-AW-Morning-Memo
tasks.summary: ONE consolidated daily morning memo (Verdict, State of the Union, Good/Bad, Act/Watch/Amplify, New Findings, Data Freshness, Pending + What I Need From You).

tasks.name: ODSP-AW-EOD-Closeout
tasks.summary: Nightly governance reconcile + Data Health re-verify + Audit History row + EOD Partnership Review (also written as an M-series memo) + cc-maintenance + archive-eod.

tasks.name: ODSP-AW-Weekly-Reflection
tasks.summary: Weekly reflection memo (Cadence, Skills, Memory). 20-min cap; clears well before the 1am EOD.

relatedWindowsTasks.name: ODSP-AW-EOD-Archive
relatedWindowsTasks.when: Daily 1:45 AM CST (backstop; the 1am close-out also runs it)
